$comment: Failing fidelity cases, replayed on every run by both the text-only properties and P4 (phase-1.md 9.3). Every entry must pass; a failing seed is added when it is found and stays after the fix. A case is a function of source, seed, type and, for a corpus case, its plan (FIDELITY_CASE=<source>:<seed>:<type>[:<plan>] replays it). Seeds are only stable while the generator and the family drawing code are unchanged, so an entry also keeps its reason.

cases.reason: Oracle bug in the suite, fixed: a drawn minstart date lay outside the corpus plan's project frame (date_in_range, found by P4). Dates are now drawn inside the frame.

Oracle bug in the suite, fixed: a setAttr aimed at a statement written with a macro used a value that failed validation, so it was refused as invalid-value instead of text-only. The value is now valid for its attribute.

Edit API bug (T11a task attribute intents), found by P4: setAttr milestone=false on `task t "T" { milestone depends !x }` removes the milestone statement and leaves a leaf with no size and one bound, so the engine reports task_underspecified (ok true to false). It should be refused as conflicting-attribute. Fails until T11b's fix merges.
